people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Judah and Israel were numerous as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and making merry.
translations.bsb: The people of Judah and Israel were as numerous as the sand on the seashore, and they were eating and drinking and rejoicing.
translations.kjv: Judah and Israel were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.
